title: 🚨 STOP PRAYING FOR A BIGGER PLATFORM IF YOU'RE NOT USING THE ONE YOU ALREADY HAVE.
paragraphs: 🚨 STOP PRAYING FOR A BIGGER PLATFORM IF YOU'RE NOT USING THE ONE YOU ALREADY HAVE.
But many Christians keep asking God for more influence while doing very little with the influence He has already given them.
And most of it sits unused.
Meanwhile, millions of people are consuming content every day that pulls them further from God.
Who will create content that points them back to Christ?
This is not a book about becoming famous.
It's a book about becoming faithful.
It's a practical guide for Christians who want to use books, videos, social media, writing, business, and content creation to glorify God and advance the Gospel.
This book answers that question with a powerful YES.
✅ How to create from your identity in Christ instead of chasing validation
✅ Why most creators burn out and how to avoid it
✅ How to build content that actually disciples people
✅ Biblical principles for consistency, excellence, and stewardship
✅ How to stop worshiping algorithms and start serving God's mission
✅ A practical framework for creating content with eternal impact
